series.en: We can use the adverb ultimately to say finally, after a series of events.
series.zh: 我们可以使用副词“ultimately”来表示“最终”，即在一系列事件发生之后。

series.en: In the mid 1800s, a series of reform movements tried to modernize Mexico.
series.zh: 在19世纪中期，一系列改革运动试图使墨西哥实现现代化。

series.en: Rowling. The Harry Potter series, all seven novels, are the best-selling book series in history.
series.zh: 罗琳的《哈利·波特与魔法石》。《哈利·波特》系列的所有七部小说是历史上最畅销的书籍系列。

series.en: Rowling. The Harry Potter series, all seven novels, are the best-selling book series in history.
series.zh: 罗琳的《哈利·波特与魔法石》。《哈利·波特》系列的所有七部小说是历史上最畅销的书籍系列。

series.en: We can use the adverb ultimately to mean finally, after a series of events have happened.
series.zh: 我们可以使用副词“ultimately”来表示“最终”，即经过一系列事件之后发生的事情。

section.en: Eventually, the French, American, and British sections merged together into West Germany.
section.zh: 最终，法国、美国和英国的占领区合并成了西德。

section.en: You probably can guess this from my previous section, clearing up the institutions and the common misconceptions.
section.zh: 你大概从我之前理顺各大机构和常见误区的那一部分就能猜到这一点。

section.en: The takeaway from this section for you guys listening is that success isn’t always simple or binary.
section.zh: 这一部分对收听节目的你们来说，收获就是成功并不总是简单或非黑即白的。

section.en: We have something called nostalgia. I introduced it in the vocabulary section.
section.zh: 我们有一种叫做“怀旧”的情绪。我在词汇部分介绍过它。

section.en: Some early sections were built more than two thousand years ago, while later parts were expanded during the Ming dynasty between the fourteenth and seventeenth centuries.
section.zh: 一些早期地段修建于两千多年前，而后期部分则在明朝十四至十七世纪期间进行了扩建。

sense.en: Having a balance between the two gives you a more complete sense of progress.
sense.zh: 在两者之间保持平衡能让你对进步有更完整的感知。

sense.en: From one perspective, the fact these countries are changing their immigration policies makes sense.
sense.zh: 从某种角度来看，这些国家改变移民政策是有道理的。

sense.en: They stood their ground, buoyed by the sense that this time, something was different.
sense.zh: 他们坚守阵地，受到了一种这次有所不同的感觉的鼓舞。

sense.en: Over time, you will develop a natural sense of what’s appropriate or what’s not appropriate.
sense.zh: 随着时间的推移，你将对什么得体、什么不得体培养出一种自然的语感。

sense.en: Dogs bred for hunting, with speed, stamina, and an exceptional sense of smell.
sense.zh: 为狩猎而培育的狗，具备速度、耐力和非凡的嗅觉。

serious.en: Earthquake risk is another serious concern, as the city sits near major fault lines.
serious.zh: 地震风险是另一个严重的问题，因为该市靠近主要断层线。

serious.en: And the reason this was treated as a serious crime was not simply religious.
serious.zh: 这种行为被当作严重罪行处理，原因不仅仅是宗教方面的。

serious.en: And during all of this, the country was in a serious state of decay.
serious.zh: 正是在这一切发生的同时，国家却在严重腐烂。

serious.en: There were also economic problems becoming quite serious in the 1970s and’80s.
serious.zh: 到了 20 世纪 70 和 80 年代，经济问题也变得相当严重。

serious.en: Now, while both of these are perhaps interesting ideas, they have never gained serious traction.
serious.zh: 现在，虽然这两个可能都是有趣的想法，但它们从未真正获得广泛认可。

sensitivity.en: “Was that change stressful for you?” However, these questions require cultural sensitivity.
sensitivity.zh: “那个变化对你来说压力大吗？”然而，这些问题需要具备文化敏感性。

sensitivity.en: Hypervigilance, the noun, is a state of extreme alertness and sensitivity to surroundings, possibly of extreme anxiety.
sensitivity.zh: 名词 hypervigilance（过度警觉）是一种对周围环境极度警惕和敏感的状态，可能伴随极度焦虑。

sensitivity.en: Euphemisms can show kindness, respect, and sensitivity.
sensitivity.zh: 委婉语可以表达善意、尊重和关怀。

sensitivity.en: They are a way to be polite in social settings, and because politeness and sensitivity are cultural things (what is considered polite or rude differs between cultures) euphemisms reflect cultural attitudes about what is considered appropriate or respectful to say in public.
sensitivity.zh: 它们是在社交场合中保持礼貌的一种方式，而且由于礼貌和敏感度因文化而异（什么被认为是礼貌或粗鲁在不同文化中有所不同），委婉语反映了公众认为哪些言论得体或尊重的文化态度。

session.en: Force yourself to just use English. Maybe incorporate English only sessions into your daily life.
session.zh: 强迫自己只使用英语。也许可以将纯英语时段融入你的日常生活中。

session.en: This study involved long, aggressive interrogation sessions designed to break down the participants’ beliefs.
session.zh: 这项研究涉及长期、具有攻击性的审讯环节，旨在瓦解参与者的信念。

session.en: The "experimenter" was the leader of the session, and would explain how the study would work.
session.zh: “主试者”是整场实验的主导者，负责讲解实验的具体流程。

session.en: Reporter John Laurenson attended one of these tasting sessions for BBC World Service programme The Food Chain.
session.zh: 记者 John Laurenson 为 BBC World Service 节目《The Food Chain》参加了其中一场品鉴会。

session.en: So they asked me, a volunteer, to come in and help translate some kind of educational session.
session.zh: 所以他们找了我这个志愿者来帮忙翻译某种教育培训会议。

senior.en: And rather than calling someone “old”, people might say “senior citizen” or “elderly “.
senior.zh: 人们不说某人“old（老）”，而可能会说“senior citizen（老年公民）”或“elderly（上了年纪的人）”。

senior.en: And currently two sisters, Ellie and Rachel Reeves, are senior ministers in the British government.
senior.zh: 目前还有两姐妹埃利和蕾切尔·里夫斯，她们是英国政府的高级大臣。

senior.en: Bush, George Bush senior, were elected directly following their term as Vice President.
senior.zh: 布什，也就是老布什，是在副总统任期结束后直接当选总统的。

senior.en: Victoria Reed is senior curator at the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston.
senior.zh: 维多利亚·里德是波士顿美术博物馆的高级策展人。

senior.en: Johnson eventually resigned after dozens of ministers, senior politicians, quit his government.
senior.zh: 在数十名部长和高级政治人物退出其政府后，Johnson最终辞职了。

setting.en: To make matters worse, the Germans changed the settings every single night at midnight.
setting.zh: 更糟糕的是，德国人每天午夜都会准时更改设置。

setting.en: I’d also recommend that you try setting both personal and professional or academic goals.
setting.zh: 我也建议你尝试同时设定个人目标以及职业或学业目标。

setting.en: This can help reduce any accidental mistakes and improve your confidence in any setting.
setting.zh: 这可以帮助减少任何意外的错误，并提高你在任何环境下的自信心。

setting.en: It's unpredictable, it is aggressive, and it's very hard to keep in a " domestic " setting.
setting.zh: 它难以预测、极具攻击性，而且很难将其保持在“家养”的环境中。

setting.en: It could work out contradictions. These were settings that were mathematically impossible.
setting.zh: 它可以计算出矛盾项——也就是数学上根本不可能存在的设置。

sentence.en: They do things like apologizing for their language level or hesitating before every sentence.
sentence.zh: 他们会做一些诸如为自己的语言水平道歉，或者在每个句子前犹豫不决的事情。

sentence.en: As a general rule, try to ask a question in one clear sentence.
sentence.zh: 作为一个一般规则，尽量用一个清晰的句子来提出问题。

sentence.en: I memorized word lists, studied grammar rules from a textbook, and practiced writing example sentences.
sentence.zh: 我背诵单词表，从教科书中死记硬背语法规则，并练习写例句。

sentence.en: Yay! The book also contains lots of very long sentences, including one with over 900 words.
sentence.zh: 耶！这本书还包含许多非常长的句子，其中有一个句子超过900个词。

sentence.en: It can be a full sentence, a quick phrase, or just a word.
sentence.zh: 它可以是一个完整的句子、一个简短的短语，或者仅仅是一个词。

sensible.en: Now was the question of how to divide up those days into sensible chunks.
sensible.zh: 现在的问题是如何把这些天数划分成合理的块。

sensible.en: He was stubborn, certainly; he resisted American independence for longer than was sensible.
sensible.zh: 他的确很固执；他抵抗美洲独立的时间比理智的做法要长。

sensible.en: That sounds sensible to me, and it also means I won't feel bad about eating chocolate now and then.
sensible.zh: 这听这也挺合理的，这也意味着我偶尔吃巧克力也不会感到内疚。

sensible.en: More people competing for the same number of homes pushes up both rents and prices, regardless of how sensible or well-intentioned housing policy might be.
sensible.zh: 更多的人竞争相同数量的房屋，这会把租金和房价同时推高，无论住房政策有多明智或出于多好的善意。

sensible.en: And if you are lucky enough to have some extra cash and are looking for a sensible investment opportunity, historically buying property and renting it out has been considered a good option.
sensible.zh: 如果你足够幸运，手头有一些闲钱，又在寻找一个明智的投资机会，那么从历史来看，买房并把它出租一直被认为是一个不错的选择。

security.en: The national security advisor would request funding from the government for a security emergency.
security.zh: 国家安全顾问会以应对安全紧急情况为由向政府申请资金。

security.en: The national security advisor would request funding from the government for a security emergency.
security.zh: 国家安全顾问会以应对安全紧急情况为由向政府申请资金。

security.en: He cultivated connections with businessmen, security officials, and younger members of the royal family.
security.zh: 他与商人、安全官员以及王室年轻一代建立了联系。

security.en: When it exploded, injuring a security officer, his 17-year campaign of violence had begun.
security.zh: 当它爆炸并炸伤一名保安时，他长达 17 年的暴力行动开始了。

security.en: If fighting breaks out, the UN Security Council can respond to the crisis.
security.zh: 如果爆发战斗，联合国安理会就可以对危机作出反应。

severe.en: When global oil prices started to fall, Venezuela’s economy entered a severe crisis.
severe.zh: 当全球油价开始下跌时，委内瑞拉经济陷入了严重危机。

severe.en: But the fact the country was so reliant on oil made these problems far more severe.
severe.zh: 但该国如此严重依赖石油这一事实，使得这些问题变得更加严重。

severe.en: These are not the symptoms of a blood disease; they are the hallmarks of severe mania.
severe.zh: 这些都不是血液疾病的症状；它们是严重躁狂症的标志。

severe.en: Berlin and all of Germany also experienced severe economic crisis and a lot of social tension.
severe.zh: 柏林和整个德国也经历了严重的经济危机和许多社会紧张局势。

severe.en: Mark says the report's conclusions are stark – an adjective which in this case means obvious or severe.
severe.zh: Mark 说报告的结论是 stark——在这个语境中，这个形容词的意思是显而易见的或严峻的。

secondary.en: A side effect is an unexpected secondary effect of a drug or medicine.
secondary.zh: 副作用是指药物或医学治疗中意想不到的次要作用。

secondary.en: And finally, a side effect is an unexpected, and usually unwanted, secondary effect of a drug or medicine.
secondary.zh: 最后，副作用是指药物或医学治疗中意想不到的、通常是不良的次要作用。

secondary.en: And for those of us that were into it before, we saw the prices – the secondary market prices – like, explode once the pandemic happened, because you had people that had time on their hands, maybe they had extra money because they're not spending it by going out, and now they're putting it into collecting toys.
secondary.zh: 对于我们这些之前就沉迷其中的人来说，我们眼睁睁看着价格——二级市场的价格——在疫情爆发后简直爆炸式增长，因为你发现人们有了大把空闲时间，他们可能有了额外的钱，因为他们不用出门花钱，现在他们把钱投入到了收集玩具中。

secret.en: Sharks aren't the only migratory animal that acts as a secret weapon against climate change.
secret.zh: 鲨鱼并不是唯一能充当对抗气候变化'秘密武器'的迁徙动物。

secret.en: After all, a secret society that everyone knows about isn’t a very good secret society.
secret.zh: 毕竟，人人都知道的秘密社团可算不上什么好秘密社团。

secret.en: After all, a secret society that everyone knows about isn’t a very good secret society.
secret.zh: 毕竟，人人都知道的秘密社团可算不上什么好秘密社团。

secret.en: Sophie says that many animals that migrate, like sharks, are a secret weapon against climate change.
secret.zh: Sophie 说，像鲨鱼这样的许多迁徙动物，都是对抗气候变化的'秘密武器'(secret weapon)。

secret.en: A giveaway is something that makes it easy for people to discover something secret or unknown.
secret.zh: A giveaway 是指让人们很容易发现秘密或未知事物的东西。

search.en: Millions of people flooded from the countryside to the cities in search of work.
search.zh: 数百万农村人口涌入城市寻找工作。

search.en: While searching for employment, Ramanujan began to interact with some of India’s top mathematicians.
search.zh: 在寻找工作的同时，Ramanujan开始与印度一些顶尖的数学家交流。

search.en: Scanning involves searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing.
search.zh: “观察”（Scanning）包括用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西。

search.en: People moved from rural areas into the city, in search of factory work.
search.zh: 人们为了寻找工厂工作，从农村地区涌入城市。

search.en: And a search of the cabin revealed everything the FBI was looking for.
search.zh: 对木屋的搜查揭示了 FBI 寻找的一切。

secondly.en: Secondly, it brings to mind the idea of him being a lifelong rat-crusher.
secondly.zh: 其次，这也让人联想到他那“终生捕鼠者”的硬汉形象。

secondly.en: Secondly, the supposed “evidence” for Otto taking the sign was flimsy at best.
secondly.zh: 其次，所谓证明奥托拿走标语的"证据"，说好听点也十分单薄。

secondly.en: And secondly, I thought the content of the episodes themselves sounded dull.
secondly.zh: 其次，我觉得节目内容本身听起来很枯燥。

secondly.en: Secondly, a series of military defeats had stripped it of territory.
secondly.zh: 其次，一系列军事失败剥夺了它的领土。

secondly.en: And secondly, it was almost certainly a joke by Caligula, and one that the historian didn’t get.
secondly.zh: 其次，这几乎肯定是 Caligula 开的一个玩笑，而这位历史学家没有听懂。

seriously.en: If you take someone seriously, you consider them important and worthy of your attention.
seriously.zh: 如果你认真对待某人（take someone seriously），你会认为他们很重要且值得你关注。

seriously.en: Yes. And so, linguistically, not taking yourself too seriously is really the done thing.
seriously.zh: 是的。所以，从语言学上讲，不把自己太当回事确实是合乎礼节的做法。

seriously.en: Potatoes originated in South America. But nobody seriously argues that fish and chips isn’t British.
seriously.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人会认真争论炸鱼薯条不是英国菜。

seriously.en: But in recent years, some new evidence has forced historians to take the question seriously.
seriously.zh: 但在最近几年，一些新的证据迫使历史学家认真对待这个问题。

seriously.en: Another nine were seriously injured, and the remaining eleven escaped with minor injuries.
seriously.zh: 另有九人重伤，其余十一人受轻伤。

separate.en: Non-identical, or fraternal, twins come from two separate eggs and share half their genes.
separate.zh: 非同卵双胞胎（即异卵双胞胎）来自两个不同的卵子，共享一半的基因。

separate.en: To filter something out means to remove or separate something unwanted from something else.
separate.zh: 过滤掉某物意味着将不需要的东西从其他东西中移除或分离出来。

separate.en: If you filter something out, you remove or separate something unwanted from a substance.
separate.zh: 如果你过滤掉某物，你就是从一种物质中移除或分离出不需要的东西。

separate.en: The phrase separated at birth can be used to describe two people with strong similarities.
separate.zh: 短语“出生时分离”可以用来描述两个有强烈相似之处的人。

separate.en: They settled on islands that were separated by vast distances of open water.
separate.zh: 他们在被广阔开阔水域隔开的岛屿上定居。

sensitive.en: And crucially for our story, North Korea is extraordinarily sensitive about its image.
sensitive.zh: 而对我们这个故事来说至关重要的一点是，朝鲜对自己的形象极度敏感。

sensitive.en: But in reality, immigration has become politically sensitive and a controversial topic in many places.
sensitive.zh: 但在现实中，移民在许多地方已经变得政治敏感且极具争议。

sensitive.en: Ted was smaller, younger, and far more sensitive than the older boys in his new class.
sensitive.zh: 泰德比他新班级里的那些大男孩更瘦小、更年轻，也敏感得多。

sensitive.en: This isn’t some productivity hack, but rather that everyone’s sense of smell is most sensitive in the morning.
sensitive.zh: 这并不是什么提高生产力的诀窍，而是因为每个人的嗅觉在早晨最为灵敏。

sensitive.en: Various animals can be used in therapy, but horses are particularly suitable as they're very sensitive to human emotions.
sensitive.zh: 各种动物都可以用于治疗，但马特别合适，因为它们对人类的情绪非常敏感。

sexual.en: Another forced them to simulate sexual acts as a way of degrading them.
sexual.zh: 还有人逼他们模拟性行为，以此来羞辱他们。

sexual.en: An aphrodisiac is a food or drink believed to increase sexual desire.
sexual.zh: Aphrodisiac是一种被认为能增加性欲的食物或饮料。

sexual.en: Like the Ancient Greeks, Jains believe that garlic stimulates sexual desire.
sexual.zh: 就像古希腊人一样，耆那教徒认为大蒜会刺激性欲。

sexual.en: And this was layered on top of the sexual depravity.
sexual.zh: 而这一切还叠加在性堕落之上。

sexual.en: And when it wasn’t humiliation and sexual depravity, he is also remembered by historians as an ineffective and cowardly leader of Rome.
sexual.zh: 当他不搞羞辱和性堕落时，历史学家也记住了他作为一个无能且懦弱的罗马领袖。

seed.en: They fished in rivers and in coastal waters and gathered seeds and fruits.
seed.zh: 他们在河流和沿海水域捕鱼，并采集种子和水果。

seed.en: But now all the YouTube doctor experts are telling us seed oils are harmful.
seed.zh: 但现在所有的油管医生专家都在告诉我们，种子油是有害的。

seed.en: On one island, finches had strong, thick beaks for cracking seeds.
seed.zh: 在一个岛上，雀类拥有强壮而厚实的喙，用来砸开种子。

seed.en: For example, adding seeds and nuts to meals.
seed.zh: 例如，在饭菜中添加种子和坚果。

seed.en: It seemed that simply seeing someone else refuse planted the seed in the participant's head that they too could do the same thing.
seed.zh: 看起来，仅仅是目睹别人拒绝，就在参与者心里埋下了一颗种子：原来自己也可以这样做。

segregate.en: And finally, if people are segregated, different groups of people are separated and kept apart.
segregate.zh: 最后，如果人们被 segregated，不同群体的人就会被分隔开来。

segregate.en: Rando Kuustik said that Estonian schools do not want to segregate students.
segregate.zh: Rando Kuustik说，爱沙尼亚的学校不想隔离学生。

seek.en: Indigenous communities continue to seek justice for the horrific and historic abuses they suffered.
seek.zh: 原住民社群仍在为他们所遭受的可怕历史虐待寻求正义。

seek.en: Whether they feared arrest or were seeking military support from abroad, historians still debate.
seek.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论他们是因为害怕被捕，还是为了在国外寻求军事支持。

seek.en: What is universal is that happiness is something humans, throughout history, have always sought.
seek.zh: 但普遍的共识是，幸福是人类在整个历史长河中一直在追求的东西。

seek.en: In August of 1971, a Stanford professor named Philip Zimbardo sought to answer this question.
seek.zh: 1971 年 8 月，斯坦福大学一位名叫 Philip Zimbardo 的教授，试图回答这个问题。

seek.en: O’Neill then sought help from Elizabeth’s great enemy, Spain, which was more than happy to assist.
seek.zh: O'Neill 随后向 Elizabeth 的宿敌西班牙寻求帮助，西班牙非常乐意提供援助。

sex.en: This was 1977. The year of the Sex Pistols and the Queen's Silver Jubilee.
sex.zh: 那是 1977 年。性手枪乐队成立以及女王登基银禧庆典的年份。

sex.en: Basically, euphemisms help people talk about difficult topics like death, money, sex, or politics, in a softer and more socially acceptable way.
sex.zh: 基本上，委婉语以一种更温和、更易于社会接受的方式，帮助人们谈论死亡、金钱、性或政治等敏感话题。

sex.en: People started to list things like child pornography and individuals to be sold as sex slaves–things that even the most devoted of libertarians knew were a step too far.
